description: This file defines an enumeration 'LoanStatus' representing various states of a loan within the project. It includes status constants with associated integer values, and methods to retrieve a status by its value.

classes.name: LoanStatus
classes.description: An enum representing different statuses of a loan with associated integer values and lookup functionality.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the loan status.

methods.name: getStatusByValue
methods.description: Retrieves the LoanStatus corresponding to a given integer value.
